newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: HUNTER DOUGLAS BUYS BELGIUM'S HELIOSCREEN.
newsitem.headline: HUNTER DOUGLAS BUYS BELGIUM'S HELIOSCREEN.

text.p: Window blinds maker Hunter Douglas NV said on Monday it had agreed to buy sunscreens producer Helioscreen in Belgium.
Helioscreen, which is based in the town of Lokeren, posted 1996 sales of 25 million guilders and has 65 employees.
No financial details of the transaction were disclosed.
Hunter Douglas said Helioscreen would continue as an independently operating unit under its present management.
The company will supply Hunter Douglas's international network of licensees as well as its own existing customers, the Dutch group said in a statement.
